summary: Tested NEW localization feature (English/Danish + weight unit g/oz + time format 12h/24h) for Skægagamer app, backend + frontend, plus regression on core flows. Backend: 13 new pytest cases in test_language_settings.py covering GET defaults, PUT persistence (both directions), non-clobbering of banner fields, Pydantic enum validation (422 on invalid language/weight_unit/time_format), and smoke regression on dragons/task-items/times/daily-overview/admin-export endpoints. Full suite 46/46 passing. Frontend: verified default English load with 'g'/12h AM-PM format; Admin 'Language & units' section (all 4 admin sections - Database/Banner/App-appearance/Language&units - render and function correctly, no leftover corruption from the reported race condition); switching language to Dansk + Save correctly re-renders tab bar (Dagsoversigt/Agamer/Ugeplaner/Opgaver/Admin) and all screen content (Overview, Dragons, Schedules categories/badges, gender labels) instantly; weight unit oz correctly converts and displays (registered 10oz -> verified backend stored 283.5g exactly, 1oz=28.3495g formula correct); time format 24h correctly reflected on Schedules slot cards and Overview task rows; reverted back to English/g/12h successfully (bidirectional toggle confirmed). Found and FIXED one real bug: Tasks>Times tab list rows were displaying raw un-formatted 'HH:MM' time strings ignoring the time_format setting (missed formatTimeDisplay wrap) plus one leftover hardcoded Danish empty-state string not using t(). Regression: dragon create (with translated gender picker Male/Female/Unknown), checkbox toggle on Overview, banner/app-appearance color pickers all working correctly.

integration_issues.flow: Admin > Language & units > Save settings toast message language
integration_issues.issue: MINOR: When switching FROM Danish TO English and pressing Save, the success toast briefly shows the OLD language's text ('Indstillinger gemt' instead of 'Settings saved'). Root cause: handleSaveLangSettings calls `await refresh()` then `showToast(t('admin.langSaveSuccess'))`, but the `t` function closure and `language` state used by useMemo in AdminSettingsContext have not yet re-rendered with the new value at the exact moment showToast is invoked (React state batching), so the toast text is one render behind. Cosmetic only - does not affect actual persisted settings or subsequent screen re-render (which is correct). Not fixed since it's a toast timing nuance, not incorrect data.

action_items: (FIXED by testing agent, no action needed) lists.tsx Tasks>Times tab now correctly applies formatTimeDisplay() to time rows and uses t('tasks.emptyTimes') instead of hardcoded Danish string.

OPTIONAL/cosmetic: consider re-ordering handleSaveLangSettings so showToast reads the *new* language value directly (e.g. pass the just-saved language into a helper, or call showToast before the language state update triggers a stale closure) to avoid the toast briefly showing in the pre-switch language. Very low priority.
No other action items - localization feature works correctly end-to-end in both directions for language, weight unit, and time format.

frontend/context/AdminSettingsContext.tsx: t() is memoized on `language` only, which is correct/expected; the toast timing issue noted above is a minor cross-cutting async state ordering nuance, not a memoization bug.

Verified no other screens (schedule.tsx, admin.tsx, index.tsx, dragons.tsx, dragon-form.tsx, dragon-weight.tsx, list-item-form.tsx, schedule-slot-form.tsx) have leftover hardcoded Danish strings via grep - all correctly route through t()/getAgeLabel()/getDayLabel()/getGenderLabel()/getCategoryLabel()/formatTimeDisplay().
